idea: Recursive “one big square plus two rectangles” construction: put a square of side s in a corner and split the remaining L-shape into two rectangles. Fill each rectangle optimally by a memoised recursion on (aspect ratio, count), where a rectangle a×b with count m is filled by a grid of ⌊b/a⌋-style columns or recursion. Optimise s over a fine set of rationals.
